hooks.name: Logo, wordmark, symbol, lockups
hooks.ask: Do you have a logo? Which versions: symbol only, horizontal and stacked lockups, one-color?

A dedicated numeric or metric style for KPIs (Fluent Bahnschrift; Atlassian `font.metric.large` 28/32) [S-L02-008, S-L02-015].

questions.ask: Use variable weights and automatic optical sizing where the font supports it?

options.l: Static fonts, discrete weights (Roboto as applied by M3 components) [S-L02-053].
Variable weight axis, including in-between weights (Polaris 450/550/650) [S-L02-014].
Variable weight plus optical size tied to font size (SF Pro, Segoe UI Variable 8-36pt, Inter opsz 14-32; Material sets opsz = font size) [S-L02-001, S-L02-022, S-L02-026].

questions.ask: What size should body text be?

options.l: 14px (Material Body Medium 14/20, Fluent, Carbon productive, Atlassian, Primer) [S-L02-006, S-L02-007, S-L02-011, S-L02-015].

questions.ask: Should text sizes change with screen width?

options.l: Fixed everywhere; rely on the OS text-size setting (Carbon productive, Windows, iOS) [S-L02-011, S-L02-022, S-L02-001].
Per-breakpoint steps (Carbon expressive at md, lg, xlg, max) [S-L02-011].
Fluid display sizes with `clamp()` within the 2.5x zoom rule [S-L02-028; DC-L02-19].

questions.ask: How far must layouts support users' larger-text settings?

options.l: Full scaling, no cap on body text
Full for content, capped at about 1.5x for fixed chrome like tab labels [DC-L10-07].

questions.ask: Which ratio should generate the size scale?

options.l: Hand-tuned list (11-15 named styles in 12 systems; only Carbon and Ant use a formula) [L09 A1 row 8].

questions.ask: How many text styles, and how should they be named?

options.l: Category plus t-shirt sizes, easy to extend (Atlassian heading.xxlarge ... ) [S-L02-015].

questions.ask: How should line heights be set, including for other scripts?

options.l: Fixed values snapped to 4pt (Material Body Large 16/24; Atlassian; Polaris) [S-L02-005, S-L02-015, S-L02-014].
Fixed values on a 2pt grid (Fluent, Carbon) [S-L02-007, S-L02-011].
Named unitless ratios (Primer tight 1.25 to loose 1.75) [DC-L02-13].

questions.ask: Which font weights, and how is emphasis shown?

options.l: Three weights (Carbon 300/400/600; Material 400/500/700; Atlassian Regular/Medium/Bold) [S-L02-012, S-L02-005, S-L02-015].
One emphasized twin per style (Material Expressive 400 to 500, 500 to 700) [S-L02-005, S-L02-006].

questions.ask: Should letter spacing tighten for big text and loosen for small text?

options.l: No tracking beyond the font's defaults [DC-L02-14].

questions.ask: How wide can paragraphs get, and how should long text be cut off?

options.l: 45-75 characters (Bringhurst) or 50-60 (Windows); WCAG 1.4.8 AAA caps at 80, 40 for CJK [S-L02-051, S-L02-022, S-L02-029].
Wrap first, then ellipsis with access to the full text [DC-L02-18].
Paragraph spacing equal to the body size (Atlassian body 12px, body large 16px) [S-L02-015; DC-L02-16].
Trim half-leading so spacing measures from cap height (CSS `text-box

questions.ask: What base unit should spacing use? 4 as the grid and 8 as the rhythm is common.

options.l: 4 as the grid, 8 as the rhythm

questions.ask: How should spacing steps grow: fine then coarse, linear, or doubling?

options.l: Fine at the bottom, coarse at the top
Linear 4px increments (Tailwind open-ended, Fluent to 56, Primer to 48) [S-L03-015, S-L03-010, S-L03-009].

questions.ask: How big must tap and click targets be?

options.l: Android 48x48dp, even for small icon buttons [S-L03-029, S-L03-058].

questions.ask: Who controls density, and how is it stored?

options.l: Fixed density, no setting (most consumer and marketing systems) [DC-L03-10].
Component size props chosen by designers (Carbon, Fluent, Primer) [S-L03-042, S-L03-046, S-L03-009].
Stored as a semantic-layer mode, separate from breakpoints and color themes; primitives and target minimums untouched [DC-L03-11].
Density follows viewing distance and input per device class ("a 65-inch TV is a far-away phone") [DC-L14-13; S-L14-026].

questions.ask: How tall should buttons and inputs be?

options.l: XS 32, S 40, M 56, L 96, XL 136dp, round or square, morphing when pressed (M3 Expressive) [S-L08-102].

questions.ask: How much more space between groups than inside them?

options.l: 1:2, the minimum for clear grouping [DC-L03-24, DC-L15-05].
Dense sections inside an uncrowded page (Carbon

questions.ask: How should spacing tokens be organized by purpose?

options.l: Inset, squish inset, stretch inset, stack, inline, grid (EightShapes) [S-L03-039].
Padding, gap, margin; "use padding and gaps before margins" (Material 3) [S-L03-030].
Separate component spacing from layout spacing (Carbon) [S-L03-001].

questions.ask: Do you need tiny nudges and negative spacing?

options.l: Nudge steps 2, 6, 10 (Fluent; Material nested units) [S-L03-010, S-L03-030].

questions.ask: How should vertical rhythm be kept?

options.l: Measure spacing from the text box; spacers snap to the text box (Carbon) [S-L03-002].
A baseline grid for multi-column content (Fluent) [S-L03-010].
Trim line-height with CSS `text-box` as progressive enhancement [S-L03-077, S-L03-039].

questions.ask: Which icon and avatar sizes should exist?

options.l: Icon sized to the button size (Material Expressive 20-40dp for XS-XL) [S-L03-059].

questions.ask: Which breakpoint set should layouts use? Material's five work across web and Android.

options.l: Material width breakpoints 600 / 840 / 1200 / 1600dp plus height classes 480 / 900 (Android and web) [S-L03-025, S-L03-021].
Apple size classes, compact or regular per axis, set by the system [S-L03-032].

questions.ask: Stretch within a layout, switch layouts at breakpoints, or both?

options.l: Responsive inside panes, adaptive between breakpoints; window size classes on Apple, Material breakpoints elsewhere [DC-L03-22, DC-L10-10].

questions.ask: How many top-level destinations, and should navigation be a bottom bar, rail, sidebar or top bar?

options.l: Bottom bar on phones (3-5), rail from 600dp, sidebar on desktop (Material; iOS floating tab bar; iPad sidebar-adaptable) [S-L08-083, S-L10-014, S-L10-025].
Sidebar at every size above compact, with groups for 7+ destinations (Carbon UI shell, Primer NavList, shadcn Sidebar) [S-L08-009, S-L08-012].
Hidden in a hamburger or drawer

questions.ask: Are most pages for reading, for working in, or for scanning data?

options.l: Material canonical layouts; never more than three panes [S-L03-027, S-L03-026].

questions.ask: Which grid, and should marketing sections use a column, modular or bento composition?

options.l: 4 / 8 / 12 columns (compact / medium / expanded), gutter 16-24, margin 16 then 24 (Material) [S-L03-026].
4 / 8 / 16 columns, 32px gutter with wide/narrow/condensed modes (Carbon) [S-L03-002, S-L03-054].
Hierarchical or bento composition for marketing; free composition only for expressive pages [DC-L15-07].

questions.ask: Should components adapt to the space they sit in (container queries) or to the window width?

options.l: Viewport media queries keyed to the breakpoints [S-L03-016].
Container queries (Baseline since 2025-08-14; Tailwind v4 ships 13 container sizes) [S-L03-056, S-L03-016].

questions.ask: Is there a shape in your logo or brand we should echo in the UI?

options.l: Logo-derived shapes as graphic elements and icon basis (Slack, Dropbox) [S-L06-030, S-L06-024].
Mixed shapes for tension, shape morph (M3 Expressive, 35 shapes) [S-L06-009].

questions.ask: How soft should corners feel: square, slightly rounded, rounded, or pill?

options.l: Size-dependent (Spectrum 6-10 by size) or concentric with the container (Apple) [DC-L09-01; S-L04-035].

questions.ask: Which radius steps should the scale have?

options.l: No scale; radii derived from the container through concentricity (Apple) [S-L04-035].

questions.ask: Should radius step up with component size, and should full circles be reserved for avatars?

options.l: None for nav and tab bars, small 2px for badges, medium, large, circular for people (Fluent 2) [S-L04-007].

questions.ask: Keep standard circular corners, or use continuous (squircle) corners where supported?
How should cards and panels separate from the page: shadows, color steps, lines, or translucent material?

options.l: 1px ring plus soft shadow (Radix, Geist, Chakra, Airbnb) [DC-L09-02].

questions.ask: How many elevation levels do you need? Four named levels is typical.

options.l: 4 semantic levels (sunken, default, raised, overlay) with hover and pressed variants (Atlassian) [S-L04-017, S-L04-018].
7 levels plus special or inset (Polaris, Primer) [S-L04-022, S-L04-024].

questions.ask: Soft layered shadows, a key-plus-ambient pair, or tucked-under shadows?

options.l: Neutral-tinted shadow color instead of black (Polaris rgba(26,26,26), Atlassian #1E1F21) [S-L04-022, S-L04-018].

questions.ask: Should navigation or overlays be translucent glass, or stay solid?

options.l: Glass on navigation and controls only, never on content (Apple Liquid Glass
Translucent menus and flyouts only; Mica for the window base (Fluent Acrylic) [S-L04-011, S-L04-012].

questions.ask: Which border widths, and should lists be separated by lines, space or surface shifts?

options.l: 1 / 2 / 4px with 1 default, 2 for focus and selection (Primer, Spectrum) [S-L03-009, S-L03-044].
Inset box-shadow borders for states that change width, so layout does not jump (Primer) [S-L04-024].

questions.ask: How dark should the backdrop behind dialogs be, and should we use Material's standard state-overlay strengths?

options.l: State overlays hover 0.08, focus 0.10, pressed 0.10, dragged 0.16, disabled 0.38 (Material 3) [S-L04-003].
Stronger overlays in dark mode (Atlassian hovered 16%/pressed 32% light, 20%/36% dark) [S-L04-070].

questions.ask: Should motion be quick and invisible, calm with a few expressive moments, or physical and bouncy?

options.l: Productive for most interactions, expressive for 1-3 hero moments per flow (Carbon expressive; Material standard vs expressive schemes) [S-L04-075, DC-L04-19].

questions.ask: Store springs as damping and stiffness, with Apple and CSS versions derived?

options.l: Duration + easing only (Carbon, Fluent, Polaris, Primer) [S-L04-014, S-L04-006].
Springs split into spatial (may overshoot) and effects (critically damped, for color and opacity) (Material fast/default/slow) [S-L04-060, S-L10-024].

questions.ask: Keep the standard duration ladder, with exits shorter than entrances?

options.l: Exits 20-35% shorter than entrances (Atlassian modal 250/200; Primer 300/200) [S-L04-018, S-L04-024].

questions.ask: Use role-based curves: standard, enter, exit, linear?

options.l: Standard / enter / exit (Carbon, Primer, Windows) [S-L04-014, S-L04-024, S-L04-013].
Practical vs bold (Atlassian); productive vs expressive (Carbon) [S-L04-018, S-L04-014].

questions.ask: Keep a simple full-round token, or add expressive shapes and morphing for a few signature moments?

options.l: `radius.full` token only (Atlassian, Polaris, Primer, Fluent, Carbon v12) [S-L04-006, S-L04-018].
Pill reserved for people and status (Atlassian; Carbon v12 moved tags away from pill) [S-L04-016, S-L04-031].
An expressive shape library with morphing (M3 Expressive `MaterialShapes`) [S-L04-005].

questions.show_if: Q-shape-01 is pill or Q-motion-01 is springs

questions.ask: Ship the four standard transitions: fade, fade-through, shared axis, container transform?

options.l: Fade for in-screen enter and exit (dialogs, menus) [DC-L04-23].
Fade through for unrelated destinations such as tabs [DC-L04-23].
Shared axis x, y or z for spatial relationships (onboarding x, stepper y, parent-child z) [DC-L04-23].
A stagger token of 20-50ms, total at most 500ms [DC-L04-23].

questions.ask: When someone turns on reduced motion, should movement become gentle fades or stop entirely?

options.l: Replace spatial motion with opacity and color changes (MDN; WCAG's motion definition excludes color, blur and opacity) [S-L04-067, S-L04-049].
Remove all non-essential motion (WCAG 2.3.3 AAA, technique C39) [DC-L04-25].

questions.ask: Do you have UI sounds or a sonic logo you want in the product? Most web and productivity apps stay silent.

options.l: Silent by default (most web systems; tvOS plays no alert sounds) [S-L04-074].
Sounds for rare, meaningful events, always behind mute and silent mode [S-L04-074].

questions.ask: Use the platform's own navigation transitions and haptics, with brand motion only inside content?

options.l: OS navigation transitions and back behavior, brand micro-motion as springs in content [DC-L10-14].
System haptics only (standard controls already play them) [S-L04-043].
A semantic haptic map of about 6 events (success, warning, error, selection, toggle, light impact) [S-L04-044, S-L04-047].

questions.ask: Honor every OS accessibility setting: screen readers, text size, contrast, reduced transparency, reduced motion, bold text, forced colors?

options.l: VoiceOver, TalkBack and ARIA labels on every icon-only control [S-L10-075, S-L10-072].
Dynamic Type, Android font scale, browser font size [DC-L10-07].

questions.ask: Do you already have icons? If not, I'd adopt a library that matches your type and corners.

options.l: Your own brand set (IBM, Atlassian 1.5px at 16px, Octicons) [S-L05-017, S-L05-021, S-L05-024].
A library extended with custom domain icons drawn on its template (Material 24dp keyline template; Apple symbol template) [S-L05-001, S-L05-010].

questions.ask: Outlined or filled icons, and should their corners match your rounded or sharp UI?

options.l: Corners matched to the radius family

questions.ask: Match icon stroke to your body text weight: about 1.5px at 16px, 2px at 24px?

options.l: Variable weight matched to text (Material wght 100-700; SF Symbols 9 weights) [S-L05-003, S-L05-010].

questions.ask: Ship 16, 20 and 24px icons on a standard 24/20/2 grid?

options.l: 24dp master, 20dp live area, 2dp padding; opsz 20-48 thins large icons (Material) [S-L05-001, S-L05-003].
16px default, 20/24/32 also, tuned to 14 and 16px text (Carbon; IBM 32px master scaled down) [S-L05-016, S-L05-017].

questions.ask: Label icons in navigation, and allow icon-only buttons just for universal actions like search and close?

options.l: Labels by default (Material navigation, Atlassian, Polaris) [S-L05-003, S-L05-021, S-L05-027].
Icon-only for about a dozen universal actions (search, close, more, add, delete, edit, share, settings), with a tooltip and accessible name [DC-L05-07].
Monochrome icons matching text color (Carbon 4.5:1, Fluent solid) [S-L05-016, S-L05-014].

questions.ask: Do you have an app icon? If so, share the layered source; if not, I can make a clearly-marked placeholder from your logo.
questions.show_if: Q-plat-01 includes ios, android or desktop, or the web app is installable

questions.ask: Ship icons as SVG with per-framework components, named by shape with function aliases?

options.l: SVG source of truth generating per-framework components and native packages (Octicons, Heroicons) [S-L05-022, S-L05-038].
Icon font or variable font (Material Symbols) [S-L05-002].
Plus a function-alias layer in the component API [DC-L05-09].

questions.ask: Symbol-only logo in the app bar and the full lockup on sign-in?

options.l: Symbol only at 24-32px in the app bar, lockup on sign-in and marketing [DC-L05-13].
Appearance brand, neutral or inverse (Atlassian Logo component) [S-L05-044].

questions.ask: Will the product show photos? If so, do you have a library or a photo brief?

options.l: Portraiture with equal stature for every subject (IBM "democratic"; Dropbox People) [S-L05-046, S-L05-057].
Still life, product or content imagery [S-L05-046].

questions.ask: Limit images to a few ratios like 16:9, 3:2 and 1:1, and keep text beside images rather than on them?

options.l: One ratio per component slot (16:9 hero, 3:2 card, 1:1 avatar) [DC-L05-15].
Text beside images (IBM avoids overlays on photos) [S-L05-047].
A scrim token under text on heroes, contrast-tested against the worst-case region [S-L05-072].

questions.ask: Circle for people, square for teams, and a third shape for AI agents?

options.l: Circle = person, square = team or org (Primer, Fluent, Atlassian) [S-L05-066, S-L05-067, S-L05-069].
Plus a distinct shape for AI agents (Primer treats bots and agents as square) [S-L05-069].

questions.ask: Do you have illustrations or a mascot? If not, should empty and error states use simple icons and text instead?

options.l: A mascot in loading, error and empty states (Mailchimp Freddie, Duolingo Duo) [S-L06-028, S-L06-026].

questions.ask: Add larger pictograms for feature grids and onboarding, drawn with the icon stroke logic?

options.l: UI icons plus a pictogram library (IBM) [S-L05-049].
UI icons only; illustrations cover larger needs (Atlassian) [S-L05-050].

questions.ask: Any animated or 3D assets to include? Otherwise I'll animate icons only to confirm actions or show status.

options.l: Built-in symbol animation (SF Symbols Appear, Bounce, Pulse, Replace, Draw) [S-L05-010, S-L05-006].
Lottie or animated illustration for onboarding and celebration [DC-L05-21].

questions.ask: Should brand shapes or motifs appear only on marketing, onboarding and empty states?
Which charts do you need? I'd start with bar, line, area, stacked bar, donut and scatter, themed on an existing library.

options.l: Bar, line, area, stacked bar, donut or meter, scatter, plus a KPI big number [DC-L05-22].
Theme an existing chart library rather than building one [DC-L05-22].

questions.ask: Do you have a voice guide? If not, give me 3-4 traits in 'X, but not Y' form and I'll draft copy examples.

options.l: Warm and relaxed, crisp and clear, ready to lend a hand (Microsoft) [S-L06-046].
Bold, optimistic, practical with a wink (Atlassian) [S-L06-060].
Custom traits on NN/g's four tone dimensions with anti-tone words [S-L06-013].

questions.ask: How should tone shift: serious for errors, warmer for success, gentler for new users?

options.l: An NN/g four-dimension profile per content type [S-L06-013].

questions.ask: Sentence case everywhere, or title case for headings and navigation?

options.l: Sentence case everywhere (Microsoft, Atlassian, Fluent) [S-L06-047, S-L06-056, S-L06-098].
Title case for headings and global nav, sentence case for buttons (Mailchimp) [S-L06-051].

questions.ask: Plain language for everyone, around a 6th-8th grade level, or 10th-12th for specialist tools?

options.l: Command labels of 2-4 words, verb first, describing the resulting state [S-L13-036].

questions.ask: Contractions yes, 'you' for the user, 'we' sparingly, and no exclamation marks in errors?

options.l: Contractions, except negative ones in high-stakes flows (GOV.UK writes "cannot") [S-L06-048].

questions.ask: Start a 20-50 term glossary and ship microcopy rules with every component?

options.l: Verb-first buttons, descriptive links (not "Click here"), blame-free fix-it errors, empty states with a next step [S-L06-052, S-L06-051].
A maintained A-Z word list (Mailchimp, Microsoft) [S-L06-014, S-L06-047].

questions.ask: Build on headless primitives, a copy-in styled layer like shadcn, web components, native controls, or adopt a full system as-is?

options.l: Web components (Polaris, Fluent UI Web Components v3) [S-L08-022, S-L08-010].
Native controls themed with your tokens (SwiftUI/UIKit, Compose Material 3) [S-L08-103, S-L08-105].
Adopt a system as-is (Material, Carbon, Fluent, Untitled UI) [S-L11-078; DC-L11-01].

questions.ask: Start with the 25 core components most systems share, and add others when two products need them?
Props for small components like Button, composable parts for containers like Dialog and Card?

options.l: Compound parts, asChild/Slot, render props (Base UI, Radix, React Aria) [S-L08-087, S-L08-088, S-L08-089].

questions.ask: Group as tokens, primitives, components, patterns and templates, with an alias table for other systems' names?
One set with device modes for phone, tablet and desktop, plus small separate libraries for watch and TV?

options.l: One set, tokens vary by mode (Spectrum desktop/mobile values; Carbon AI presence mode) [S-L03-044, S-L14-058].
Shared foundations, separate libraries per device (Wear Compose Material 3, TV Material) [S-L10-026, S-L14-025].

questions.show_if: Q-plat-02 marks watch, TV or car as first-class or works

questions.ask: Four button levels plus danger, with one primary action per region?

options.l: Primary, secondary, tertiary/outline, ghost/text, plus danger (Carbon, Fluent) [S-L08-061, S-L08-066].
5-7 levels including tonal, elevated, discovery or AI variants (M3 5; Atlassian 7 incl. Rovo) [S-L08-033, S-L08-063].

questions.ask: Strong, balanced or minimal signals that something is clickable?
A 2px ring with a 2px gap that follows each component's corners, in a color that shows on every surface?

options.l: 2px solid ring, 2px offset, radius = component radius + offset (Atlassian `radius.focus`, Primer 2px) [S-L04-016, S-L04-024].
3px ring, 2px outer offset, -3px inner offset where outside rings would clip (Material 3) [S-L04-003].
Two-tone ring (inner white, outer dark) that is 3:1 on every surface [DC-L08-11].

questions.ask: Style enabled, hover, focus, pressed, selected, disabled, loading and error, with each device rendering the states its inputs can trigger?

options.l: Overlays for hover and press (Material state layers) [S-L01-005, S-L08-095].
Explicit tokens per state and variant (Carbon) [S-L08-062].

questions.ask: Show selection with an indicator plus color, and keep brand color for actions?

options.l: Pill-shaped indicator behind the icon (M3 navigation) [S-L08-083].
Shape morph round to square (M3 Expressive toggles) [S-L08-034].

questions.ask: Subtle red in context, solid red only in the confirmation step?

options.l: Solid red danger button (Carbon, Primer, shadcn destructive) [S-L08-061, S-L08-064, S-L08-065].
Danger at several emphasis levels (Carbon danger primary/tertiary/ghost) [S-L08-061].
Separate warning (significant change) and danger (final irreversible step) (Atlassian) [S-L08-063].

questions.ask: Optional leading icons on buttons, with sentence-case verb labels?

options.l: Label left, icon right (Carbon, 16px icon) [S-L08-061, S-L08-062].
Both slots (Atlassian iconBefore/iconAfter; Primer leadingVisual/trailingVisual) [S-L08-063, S-L08-064].

questions.ask: Nothing under a second, skeletons for page loads, spinners for single actions, progress bars past ten seconds?

options.l: No indicator under 1 s, looped indicator 2-10 s, percent-done over 10 s (NN/g) [S-L13-032, S-L13-031].
Skeletons for page or region loads, spinners for modules (Carbon skeletons only on containers) [S-L13-033, S-L05-071].
Spinner inside the triggering button, which keeps focus (S2 pending after 1 s; Carbon inline loading) [S-L08-067, S-L08-061].

questions.ask: Outlined or filled fields, with labels always visible above them?

options.l: Persistent label above, hint under the label [S-L13-066].
Mark whichever of required/optional is rarer, "(optional)" or "(required)" [S-L08-106].

questions.ask: Check fields when people leave them, show a summary on submit, and never disable the submit button?

options.l: On submit with an error summary that takes focus, "Error:" prefix, inline messages (GOV.UK) [S-L08-077].
Disable submit on short forms until valid, never on long ones (Carbon) [S-L08-106].

questions.ask: Errors next to their cause, a banner only for system-level problems, a dialog only when work would be lost?

options.l: Inline field error next to the source [DC-L13-07].
Error summary at the top of the form [DC-L13-07].
Full error page for catastrophic failures [DC-L13-07].

questions.ask: Inline or banner by default, toasts only for low-stakes confirmations with undo?

options.l: Inline or banner by default; toasts only for low-stakes confirmations with undo, never auto-dismissing toasts that contain actions (Carbon matrix of 4 statuses x 7 types) [S-L08-079; DC-L13-09].
No toasts; banners and dialogs only (Primer) [S-L08-098, S-L08-012].
Toasts and flags widely (M3 snackbar, Atlassian flags) [S-L08-008, S-L08-011].

questions.ask: Offer undo for anything reversible, and confirm only irreversible or costly actions?

options.l: Undo with soft delete or trash for reversible actions (NN/g calls undo superior; Shneiderman rule 6) [S-L13-067, S-L13-037].
Confirmation dialog with specific verb labels, Cancel as the safe default [S-L13-067; DC-L13-08].
Undo for reversible, confirm for irreversible and costly [DC-L13-08].

questions.ask: Dialogs for short decisions, side sheets for editing with context, bottom sheets on phones?

options.l: Modal only with a clear benefit; sheets and popovers for scoped tasks; full-screen for immersive multi-step tasks (HIG) [S-L08-086].
Bottom and side sheets, drawers and panels (M3, Fluent, Atlassian) [S-L08-008, S-L08-010, S-L08-011].

questions.ask: Pagination for tables, load more for results, infinite scroll only for feeds?
Show primary options up front and advanced ones behind a clearly labeled trigger, at most two levels deep?

options.l: Progressive disclosure, at most two levels, trigger label says what is behind it [S-L13-063].
Staged disclosure (wizard or stepper), for independent steps only [S-L13-063].
Contextual reveal on hover or selection [DC-L13-03].

questions.ask: Designed empty states with a next step, and contextual tips instead of a forced tour?

options.l: Empty states for first use, user-cleared, no results, no permission or error (Primer Blankslate, Spectrum IllustratedMessage, shadcn Empty) [DC-L13-10; S-L08-012, S-L08-015, S-L08-018].
Contextual help and empty-state guidance at the moment of need [S-L13-070].
Interactive walkthrough, only for genuinely new, complex interfaces [S-L13-070].
